set.body: Outcome: one canonical local stimulus-ASR export format across the13fullWhispervideos,CPUreference smoke,4GPUqualification specimens,62Whisper/Parakeetcomparison outputs and15successfulQwenoutputs;include15failedQwenattempts as explicitly failed/unavailable records,not accepted text. Preserve native/history files and all scientific provenance. Uniform transcript.json,transcript.txt,words.tsv,segments.tsv and centralmanifest/catalog. Versioned localschema with explicit source/input identities, method/profile, source-video clock/offset, timing granularity/availability, uncalibrated diagnostics and outcome. Wordsnull when timing unavailable;emptyarray when available but empty. Qwen chunks remain coarseinputranges;no guessed/copiedwordtimes or model rerun. Normalize already-source trial times exactlyonce,shift excerpt-relative Qwen chunk bounds byknownoffset. Raw/historical source assets staynative and linked;no participant/recall reads or publicScalaAPI/dependency changes. Acceptance: allselectednative receipts/hash/method/clock checks before export, meaningful adversarial/synthetic offset/null/empty/failure tests, deterministic reconstruct/check, consistentJSON/TSV/TXT/readback, independent exact-export review. Storeallcontentignoreddata,notGit. Historical unreceipted legacyASR outside currentrunset remains source evidence,not silentlyadmitted intoverifiedcanonicalset.
set.title: [media] Unify verified stimulus transcript export format
